content.short: MeowSwap is a decentralized exchange on the Cardano blockchain.
content.description: MeowSwap combines a proprietary L2 scaling technology in conjunction with our DEX to offer the only working trading solution running on Cardano mainnet. We utilize Cardano's main chain to store deposits in a trustless way and log all deposits and withdrawals while L2 Nodes take the computational load on managing the exchange operations, liquidity pool managements transactions and all data-transactions.
